name: read-access-during-session
body:
While a session owns `apg/.trans/db.lbug` with an exclusive lock, external readers must still be able to read immediately. Reads route through the live session over the same transparent socket as writes (read-through routing), or the DB is opened in a mode that admits concurrent readers (multi-reader/single-writer). This requirement constrains the observable behaviour, not the mechanism.

Acceptance: with a live session that has applied a mutation, a separate `apg query` process returns the post-mutation state with no lock error and without waiting for the session to end.
